about: The owner asks why How it works files carry two .md endings and sets a new rule: every tab is a file next to its subject (vision.index.md, the file itself, vision.example.md, vision.questions.md, custom views vision.{type}.{name}.view.html, also as templates for a category), plus a metadata file with the mapping for every file and folder; asks for suggestions (maybe a changelog), to define everything and raise questions first, then do it.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
